description: PCS TCM code 1 - CAN communications lost (reported as code 1 / U0001 on some software)
likely_causes: Sets when: Same fault as PCS code 23: no CAN communications for more than 5 seconds. TCM action: See PCS code 23. Clears: See PCS code 23. Also reported as: OBD II U0001. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 21 - Throttle position high
likely_causes: Sets when: Throttle position voltage above 4.9 V for more than 1 second. TCM action: Maximum line pressure; shift points fixed at 35% throttle. Clears: Throttle position below 4.9 V for more than 1 second. Also reported as: J1939 SPN 522499 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.48; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5; J1939 SPN from the Quick Reference Guide only (the Technician's Guide lists no SPN for this code)

description: PCS TCM code 22 - Throttle position low
likely_causes: Sets when: TPS voltage below 0.20 V for more than 1 second. TCM action: Maximum line pressure; shift points fixed at 35% throttle. Clears: Throttle position above 0.20 V for more than 1 second. Also reported as: J1939 SPN 522500 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.48; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5; J1939 SPN from the Quick Reference Guide only (the Technician's Guide lists no SPN for this code)

description: PCS TCM code 23 - CAN communications lost
likely_causes: Sets when: No CAN communications for more than 5 seconds. TCM action: Maximum line pressure; shift points fixed at 35% throttle; inhibit 4th and TCC. Clears: Valid CAN message received. Also reported as: OBD II U0001, J1939 SPN 522731 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.48; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 24 - Output speed sensor
likely_causes: Sets when: No code 21, 22, U0001. Not in Park/Neutral, engine RPM above 3000, input shaft speed above 10%, output speed below 200, all for 3 seconds. TCM action: Output shaft speed calculated from input shaft speed and commanded gear; maximum line pressure. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0722, J1939 SPN 522741 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 28 - Range pressure switch / lever position error
likely_causes: Sets when: TCM sees an illegal combination from the pressure switch manifold / lever position sensor for 2 seconds. TCM action: Maximum pressure; assumes Overdrive 4 selected; inhibit 4th and TCC. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P1810, J1939 SPN 522751 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 37 - Brake switch stuck off
likely_causes: Sets when: Brake not pressed with vehicle speed below 5 mph for more than 6 s, then above 20 mph for more than 6 s, 7 times in total. TCM action: Inhibit TCC. Clears: Key cycle or when the brake pedal is pressed. Also reported as: OBD II P0719, J1939 SPN 522740 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 38 - Brake switch stuck on
likely_causes: Sets when: Brake pressed with vehicle speed below 5 mph for more than 6 s, then above 20 mph for more than 6 s, 7 times in total. TCM action: Inhibit TCC. Clears: Key cycle or when the brake pedal is pressed. Also reported as: OBD II P0724, J1939 SPN 522743 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 39 - TCC stuck off
likely_causes: Sets when: TCC slip above 65 RPM for 3 seconds when TCC is commanded on in 2nd or 3rd. TCM action: Inhibit TCC and 4th gear. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0741, J1939 SPN 522744 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 51 - Transmission control module
likely_causes: Sets when: Internal memory write/read failure, COP stops operating, or processor executes an illegal opcode. TCM action: 2nd gear, maximum line pressure, inhibit TCC. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0601, J1939 SPN 522736 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 52 - System voltage high (long)
likely_causes: Sets when: System voltage above 16 V for 30 minutes. TCM action: 2nd gear, maximum line pressure, inhibit TCC (solenoids turned off). Clears: Key cycle or system voltage below 15 V. Also reported as: OBD II P0560, J1939 SPN 522733 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 53 - System voltage high
likely_causes: Sets when: System voltage above 19.5 V for 5 seconds. TCM action: 2nd gear, maximum line pressure, inhibit TCC (solenoids turned off). Clears: Key cycle or system voltage below 18 V. Also reported as: OBD II P0561, J1939 SPN 522734 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 58 - Trans temp high or TFT circuit low
likely_causes: Sets when: Transmission temperature above 151 °C (304 °F). TCM action: Inhibit 4th and TCC. Clears: Transmission temperature below 148 °C for 5 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0712, J1939 SPN 522737 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.49; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 59 - Trans temp low or TFT circuit high
likely_causes: Sets when: Transmission temperature below -37 °C (-34 °F) for 1 second. TCM action: Inhibit 4th and TCC. Clears: Transmission temperature above -35 °C for 5 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0713, J1939 SPN 522738 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 68 - Component slipping / TCC or 4th clutch slipping
likely_causes: Sets when: No 28, 71, 74, U0001. Throttle above 25%, engine speed 200 RPM or more above input speed for 6 s in 4th with TCC engaged. TCM action: Maximum line pressure, inhibit 4th. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P1870, J1939 SPN 522753 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 69 - TCC stuck on
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 21, 22, 71, 74, U0001. TCC slip between -25 and 25 RPM with TCC commanded off and TPS above 25% for 4 seconds. TCM action: TCC commanded on, maximum line pressure. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0742, J1939 SPN 522745 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5

description: PCS TCM code 71 - Engine speed circuit low
likely_causes: Sets when: Engine speed below 50 RPM with range R, D4, D3 or D1 for 2 seconds. TCM action: Inhibit 4th and TCC. Clears: Engine RPM above 300 RPM. Also reported as: J1939 SPN 522501 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.5; J1939 SPN from the Quick Reference Guide only (the Technician's Guide lists no SPN for this code)

description: PCS TCM code 72 - Intermittent output shaft speed
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 21, 22, 28, 71, 74, U0001. Engine above 300 RPM, range D4-D1, throttle above 25%, output shaft speed changes more than 500 RPM in one measurement period. TCM action: Maximum line pressure; TOSS calculated from TISS and commanded gear. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0723, J1939 SPN 522742 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 73 - Pressure control circuit
likely_causes: Sets when: Force motor current more than 0.16 A different from commanded current for 2 seconds. TCM action: Maximum line pressure. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0748, J1939 SPN 522746 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 74 - Input speed sensor circuit
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 28. Range not Park/Neutral, engine above 300 RPM, output speed above 200 RPM, input speed below 50 RPM for 2 seconds. TCM action: Maximum line pressure; inhibit 4th and TCC. Clears: Input speed above 75 RPM for 2 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0717, J1939 SPN 522739 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.50; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 75 - System voltage low
likely_causes: Sets when: Ignition on, engine above 300 RPM for 4 s, and voltage below the temperature-dependent limit: -40 °C = 7.3 V, 90 °C = 10.3 V, 150 °C = 11.7 V. TCM action: 2nd gear with maximum pressure; inhibit TCC (solenoids turned off). Clears: System voltage above the same limits for 4 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0562, J1939 SPN 522735 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.51; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 79 - Transmission fluid overtemp
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 58. Transmission fluid temperature above 132 °C (270 °F) for 5 minutes. TCM action: None. Clears: Temperature below 130 °C (266 °F) for 5 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0218, J1939 SPN 522732 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.51; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 81 - Shift solenoid B (2-3) circuit fault
likely_causes: Sets when: Battery above 10 V and TCM detects open, short to battery, short to ground or over-current on the shift solenoid B circuit for 2 seconds. TCM action: 2nd or 3rd gear only; maximum line pressure (solenoids turned off). Clears: Fault condition removed for 2 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0758, J1939 SPN 522750 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.51; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 82 - Shift solenoid A (1-2) circuit fault
likely_causes: Sets when: Battery above 10 V and TCM detects open, short to battery, short to ground or over-current on the shift solenoid A circuit for 2 seconds. TCM action: 2nd and 3rd only, or 1st and 4th only; maximum line pressure (solenoids turned off). Clears: Fault condition removed for 2 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P0753, J1939 SPN 522748 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.51; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 83 - TCC solenoid circuit fault
likely_causes: Sets when: Battery above 10 V and TCM detects open, short to battery, short to ground or over-current on the TCC solenoid circuit. TCM action: Inhibit TCC; inhibit 4th in hot mode. Clears: Fault condition removed for 2 seconds. Also reported as: OBD II P1860, J1939 SPN 522752 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.51; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 84 - Accelerator pedal performance
likely_causes: Sets when: Measured throttle voltage difference exceeds allowable tolerance. TCM action: Assume 0% throttle. Clears: Key cycle. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 85 - Undefined ratio error
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 21, 22, 24, 28, 71, 72, U0001. RPM above 300, TPS above 25%, VSS above 7 mph, ratio outside the gear limits for 6 s (1st 2.38-2.63, 2nd 1.43-1.58, 3rd 0.95-1.05, Rev 1.97-2.17). TCM action: 2nd gear with maximum line pressure, inhibit TCC. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P1871, J1939 SPN 522754 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.51; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 86 - Low ratio error (shift solenoid B stuck on)
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 21, 22, 24, 28, 71, 72, 74, 85, U0001. RPM above 300, TPS above 25%, VSS above 7 mph, ratio matches 4th when 1st commanded or 3rd when 2nd commanded, for 6 s. TCM action: 2nd gear with maximum line pressure, inhibit TCC. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0756, J1939 SPN 522749 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 87 - High ratio error (shift solenoid B stuck off)
likely_causes: Sets when: No DTC 21, 22, 24, 28, 71, 72, 74, 85, U0001. RPM above 300, TPS above 25%, VSS above 7 mph, ratio matches 1st when 4th commanded or 2nd when 3rd commanded, for 6 s. TCM action: 2nd gear with maximum line pressure, inhibit TCC. Clears: Key cycle. Also reported as: OBD II P0751, J1939 SPN 522747 (PCS proprietary; FMI not given in the guide). Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 91 - Non-idle inch
likely_causes: Sets when: TPS above 15% or RPM above 800 during inching. TCM action: Transmission locked (hold vehicle). Clears: Key cycle. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 92 - Movement not commanded
likely_causes: SAFETY: uncommanded movement fault. Chock the wheels and keep clear of the aircraft before any test. Sets when: Output shaft movement detected when not commanded. TCM action: Transmission locked (hold vehicle). Clears: Key cycle. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 93 - Inching past target
likely_causes: SAFETY: movement fault. Chock the wheels and keep clear of the aircraft before any test. Sets when: Output shaft movement detected past the desired stopping point. TCM action: Transmission locked (hold vehicle). Clears: Key cycle. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 94 - Forward clutch solenoid circuit fault
likely_causes: SAFETY: the guide warns an electrical failure of the clutch solenoid could result in unpredictable vehicle movement. Chock the wheels and keep clear of the aircraft. Sets when: Forward clutch current more than 0.16 A different from commanded current for 2 seconds. TCM action: Transmission commanded to neutral. Clears: Key cycle. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 95 - Reverse clutch solenoid circuit fault
likely_causes: SAFETY: the guide warns an electrical failure of the clutch solenoid could result in unpredictable vehicle movement. Chock the wheels and keep clear of the aircraft. Sets when: Reverse clutch current more than 0.16 A different from commanded current for 2 seconds. TCM action: Transmission commanded to neutral. Clears: Key cycle. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4LHD/4LHDX Technician's Guide v2.0, Section 4 Diagnostic Trouble Codes, p.52; PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6

description: PCS TCM code 98 - Anti-collision system fault
likely_causes: SAFETY: the anti-collision system is disabled while this code is set. Sets when: No communication with the anti-collision module, or an anti-collision DTC. TCM action: Disable anti-collision system. Clears: Valid communication received or anti-collision fault cleared. Follow the PCS Technician's Guide procedure for this code.
source_citation: PCS 4-Speed Transmission Quick Reference Guide v1.3, DTC table p.6
